chunks: And Paradise will be brought near, not far from those who took heed for themselves and feared God.
ai.seo_question: What happens to Paradise for the righteous on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the immediate accessibility of Paradise for the *al-muttaqin*, contrasting with the distant Hell for the wicked, emphasizing that divine reward is not a distant promise but an imminent reality for the pious. The phrase 'non-distant' (ghayra ba'id) underscores the ease with which God grants entry to those who cultivated taqwa through obedience and spiritual refinement. This concept reinforces the Shia emphasis on the tangible closeness of the Divine to the righteous in the Hereafter.
